events.title: FGO Summer 2026 Event - BB Presents☆Celeb Summer Experience! Dubai's Counterattack

participation.value: BB Presents☆Celeb Summer Experience! Dubai's Counterattack Masters who have fulfilled the following requirements may participate. - Clear "Singularity F: Flame Contaminated City, Fuyuki" Ordeal Call III: Bellum Novae Humanitatis, Archetype Inception Masters who have fulfilled the following requirements may participate. - Clear Main Quest Section 13 of the Limited Time Event "BB Presents☆Celeb Summer Experience! Dubai's Counterattack" - Clear Prologue "Ordeal Call 0" * Please note that if you do not clear Main Quest Section 13 of "BB Presents☆Celeb Summer Experience! Dubai's Counterattack" by 2026-09-01 20:59 PDT (GMT -7), you will not be able to unlock the event's continuation, Ordeal Call III. * It will not be necessary to clear Pseudo-Singularities (I-IV), Main Quest Part 2 Chapters 5.5 and 6.5, Ordeal Call I, or Ordeal Call II.
